name: Feature Edge Definition
definition: The clarity and distinctness of the boundaries separating individual features or structures from their surroundings.

name: Feature Size Disparity
definition: The extent of variation in the characteristic dimensions (e.g., length, width, diameter) among individual features within the image.

name: Feature Overlap
definition: The extent to which individual features visually obscure or stack upon one another, creating layers or depth.

name: Background Clutter
definition: The degree to which the non-feature areas of the image contain extraneous, unresolved, or indistinct material.

name: Feature Edge Curvature Uniformity
definition: The consistency in the degree of curvature along the edges of individual features.

name: Feature Termination Sharpness
definition: This concept quantifies the sharpness and abruptness of the ends of elongated or distinct features.

name: Feature Smoothness
definition: The degree to which the visible aspects (surfaces, walls, or edges) of distinct features appear free from texture, roughness, or irregularities.

name: Feature Internal Structure Visibility
definition: This concept assesses the clarity and presence of discernible internal structures or hollow regions within individual features.

name: Surface Texture Fineness
definition: This concept quantifies the characteristic scale of the smallest discernible textural elements on a surface.

name: Discrete Particle Density
definition: The number of distinct, individual particles or features present on a relatively uniform background.

name: Background Uniformity
definition: The degree to which the background or underlying substrate appears homogeneous in texture and intensity, free from significant patterns or variations.

name: Linear Feature Parallelism
definition: The extent to which linear features within the image are aligned parallel to each other.

name: Feature Depth Perception
definition: The visual impression of three-dimensional depth and height differences among features, often indicated by strong shadows or perspective.

name: Feature Volume Fraction
definition: The proportion of the image area occupied by distinct, high-contrast features relative to the background or matrix.

name: Feature Interstitial Space
definition: The extent of visible empty or low-density space between distinct features.

name: Background Texture Homogeneity
definition: The uniformity of the underlying background or matrix texture, excluding distinct foreground features.

name: Feature Material Loss
definition: The degree to which the primary features exhibit missing or eroded material, leading to gaps or incomplete structures.

name: Feature Aspect Ratio Homogeneity
definition: The uniformity in the ratio of length to width (or major to minor axis) among distinct features in the image.

name: Feature Brightness Uniformity
definition: The consistency of the grayscale intensity (brightness) within and across the primary features.

name: Surface Relief Texturing
definition: Measures the presence and prominence of fine, consistent, and intentional three-dimensional patterns or markings on a surface.
